run_relax_job: run a geometry optimization job on an ASE Atoms structure using a calculator and optimization flags
run_single_point_job: run a single-point energy and force calculation on an ASE Atoms structure with a calculator
run_conformers: run conformer energy and geometry calculations on molecular conformers organized by molecule families
run_protonation: run protonation state energy and geometry calculations on molecules organized by molecule families
run_spin_gap: run unoptimized spin gap energy calculations on structures at different spin multiplicities
